note: This config is the single source of truth for the compliance engine. Do not hardcode thresholds in application code — always read from here. Some entries are marked NEEDS_VERIFICATION where the exact legal text should be re-checked against the current official gazette notification before this is relied on for real enforcement decisions.

mandatory_declarations.description: Name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer; for imported packages, the name and address of the importer.
Country of origin, applicable only for imported products.
The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package.
Net quantity of the commodity in the package, expressed in standard units of weight, measure, or number.
Retail sale price (MRP), which must be inclusive of all taxes.
Month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, packed, or imported.
Name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address (if available) of the person or office that can be contacted for consumer complaints/grievances.

font_and_readability.description: Height of letters in any declaration shall not be less than 1 mm.
Where a declaration is blown, formed, molded, embossed, or perforated, the height of letters shall not be less than 2 mm.
font_and_readability.applies_if: surface_treatment in [blown, formed, molded, embossed, perforated]

font_and_readability.description: Width of a letter or numeral shall not be less than one-third of its height (exceptions: numeral '1' and letters i, I, l).

NEEDS_VERIFICATION — minimum numeral height for net-quantity/MRP declarations varies by declared net quantity slab (Table I: by weight/volume; Table II: by length/area/number), ranging roughly 1mm-6mm. Exact slab breakpoints must be transcribed from the official gazette text before this is used for automated readability checks.

structural_rules.description: Principal display panel area basis: rectangular packages use one full side's surface area; cylindrical/pipe-shaped packages use 40% of height x circumference; other shapes use 40% of total surface area. Top/bottom/flanges/shoulders/necks are excluded from this calculation.

exemptions.description: Packages sold by weight/measure amounting to less than 10 g or 10 ml (except tobacco products) are exempt from the standard declaration requirements.
Commodities packed in quantities greater than 25 kg or 25 litre (50 kg for cement and fertilizer) are exempt from retail-package-specific requirements.
Fast food items packed by hotels/restaurants/similar establishments for direct sale are exempt.
Scheduled and non-scheduled drugs covered under the Drugs (Price Control) Order, 1995 are exempt from these specific declarations (other drug-labeling laws apply instead).

ecommerce_note.description: E-commerce entities must display all Rule 6(1) mandatory declarations on the digital/electronic listing, EXCEPT the month and year of manufacture/packing, which is not required on the online listing itself.
